item.title: Kim Min-seok's 'Shincheonji intervention in party convention' claims… Jeong Cheong-rae says "false, will take legal action" (김민석 ‘전당대회 신천지 개입설’에…정청래 “허위, 법적 조치할 것”)
item.description:
Allegations of 'Shincheonji intervention' are emerging in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party convention leadership race. Candidate Kim Min-seok has taken the lead in raising suspicions, with Candidate Song Young-gil joining in. Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae has signaled a strong response, stating, "I will take legal action against every single one." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 경선에 ‘신천지 개입설’이 불거지고 있다. 김민석 후보가 주도적으로 의혹을 제기하고 송영길 후보가 가세하면서다. 정청래 후보는 “족족 법적 조처를 하겠다”며 강력한 대응을 예고했다.)

After a 'meeting invited candidates for party leader' held at the Seoul Metropolitan Council in Jung-gu, Seoul on the 21st, Candidate Kim met with reporters and said, "Breaking the triple alliance of 'anti-Myung,' 'factionalism,' and 'Shincheonji' is the essence of this party convention," adding, "I will point out one by one the fact that the 'Shincheonji special counsel' was not pursued." In a radio interview with MBC on the same day, he added, "When I first warned about martial law, everyone said I was crazy and asked what I was talking about. I am also watching the Shincheonji issue very specifically and carefully. I will speak up at appropriate times." However, Candidate Kim did not provide specific evidence. (김 후보는 21일 서울 중구 서울시의회에서 열린 ‘당대표 후보자 초청 간담회’를 마친 뒤 취재진과 만나 “‘반명’ ‘분열주의’ ‘신천지’의 3자 연합을 깨는 것이 이번 전당대회의 본질”이라며 “‘신천지 특검’이 진행되지 않은 점 등을 하나하나 짚어가겠다”고 말했다. 그는 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 인터뷰에서도 “제가 계엄을 처음 경고할 때 다들 정신 나갔다고 뭔 소리냐 이랬는데, 신천지 문제도 아주 구체적이고 주의 깊게 보고 있다”며 “적정한 시기마다 말하겠다”고 덧붙였다. 다만, 김 후보는 구체적인 근거는 내놓지 않았다.)

Candidate Kim's mention of Shincheonji is interpreted as targeting Candidate Jeong. (김 후보의 신천지 언급은 정 후보를 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다.)

On YouTube, videos claiming that Candidate Jeong attended Shincheonji events in the past are circulating, along with assertions that Candidate Jeong, as the party leader at the time, bore significant responsibility for the collapse of the 'Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel' earlier this year. It appears that messages are being sent to party members suggesting that Shincheonji followers are supporting Candidate Jeong to foment division within the ruling camp. An aide to Candidate Kim stated, "During the 2021 Democratic Party presidential primary, circumstances indicating political intervention by a specific religious group were revealed; this is an extension of that issue." (유튜브에서는 정 후보가 과거 신천지 행사에 참석했다고 주장하는 영상과 함께 올해 초 ‘통일교·신천지 특검’이 무산된 배경에는 당시 대표였던 정 후보의 책임이 적지 않다는 주장이 돌고 있다. 신천지 신도들이 정 후보를 지지해 여권 내 분열을 꾀하려 한다는 메시지를 당원들에게 발신한 것으로 보인다. 김 후보 쪽 의원은 “2021년 민주당 대선 경선 당시 특정 종교 집단의 정치 개입 정황이 드러난 바 있는데 그 연장선의 문제 제기”라고 말했다.)

Candidate Song also joined in. On the same day, Candidate Song wrote on Facebook, "I heard a shocking story about the meeting between Shincheonji leader Lee Man-hee and senior member Hong Jun-pyo after the 2021 People Power Party presidential primary. I will cross-check a few things and then talk about it on a broadcast." This suggested an atmosphere that cases of Shincheonji intervening in the People Power Party's internal primary could also occur within the Democratic Party. (송 후보도 가세했다. 송 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “(2021년 국민의힘) 대선 (경선) 후 이만희 (신천지) 교주와 홍준표 선배가 직접 만나 나눈 충격적인 이야기를 들었다. 몇가지 크로스체크를 한 후 방송에서 이야기하도록 하겠다”고 적었다. 신천지가 국민의힘 당내 경선에 개입했던 사례가 민주당에도 있을 수 있다는 분위기를 풍긴 것이다.)

Candidate Jeong responded strongly, calling it "false fabricated information" and "fake news." Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly, he said, "They keep bringing up Shincheonji and pretending as if I am related, but if they get caught, I will take legal action against every single one." (정 후보는 “허위 조작 정보” “가짜뉴스”라며 격한 반응을 보였다. 그는 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “자꾸 신천지 얘기하면서 마치 저하고 관련이 있는 것처럼 연기를 피우는데, 걸리면 족족 다 법적 조치를 하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the claim that he intentionally did not push for the Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel as party leader, Candidate Jeong said, "At the time, we were conducting multiple special counsels, and due to a shortage of dispatched prosecutors, the party, government, and presidential office coordinated to have the joint investigation unit of the prosecution and police handle the case." Regarding the YouTube videos claiming he attended Shincheonji-related events, he said, "It was a district office event where then-Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol also attended and gave a congratulatory speech." Candidate Lee Seong-yoon, a close associate of Candidate Jeong and candidate for the Supreme Council, opposed on Facebook, saying, "Spreading baseless suspicions to sow discord within and foster distrust is a method used only by cults." (정 후보는 당대표 당시 통일교·신천지 특검을 일부러 추진하지 않았다는 주장에 대해서는 “당시 특검을 여러개 하다 보니 파견 검사가 부족하다고 해 검찰·경찰 합동수사본부가 수사하는 걸로 하자고 당·정·청이 조율한 것”이라고 말했다. 신천지 관련 행사에 자신이 참여했다고 하는 유튜브 영상에 대해서는 “구윤철 당시 기획재정부 차관도 참석해 축사도 한 지역구 행사”라고 말했다. 정 후보와 가까운 이성윤 최고위원 후보는 페이스북에 “근거 없는 의혹을 퍼뜨려 내부를 이간질하고, 불신을 조장하여 이득을 보는 건 사이비 종교나 쓰는 방법”이라고 반발했다.)

Amidst this, Candidate Jeong's side announced that after completing a joint campaign speech for party leader candidates at the Democratic Party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul the previous day, the vehicle carrying Candidate Jeong was damaged by an external impact. Candidate Jeong said, "I have requested an investigation by the police." (이런 가운데 정 후보 쪽은 전날 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당사에서 당대표 후보 합동연설회를 마친 뒤 정 후보가 탄 차량이 외부의 가격을 받아 파손됐다고 밝혔다. 정 후보는 “경찰에 수사 의뢰를 했다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party decided that day to reduce the candidate deposits for the party leader and Supreme Council elections by 20 million won each. Rep. Im Ho-seon, the deputy chairman of the party's election management committee, told reporters after the committee's plenary meeting at the National Assembly, "The candidate deposits (combining preliminary and main primaries) were set at 80 million won for party leader candidates and 30 million won for Supreme Council candidates." The deposits for this party convention were originally 100 million won for party leader candidates and 50 million won for Supreme Council candidates. On the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung suggested on X, "If possible, how about considering restoring the deposits to their previous levels?" (한편, 민주당은 이날 당대표·최고위원 선거 후보 기탁금을 각각 2천만원씩 낮추기로 결정했다. 당 선거관리위원회 부위원장인 임호선 의원은 선관위 전체회의를 마친 뒤 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “(예비경선과 본경선을 합한) 후보자 기탁금을 당대표 후보는 8천만원, 최고위원 후보는 3천만원으로 각각 확정했다”고 말했다. 이번 전당대회 기탁금은 당대표 후보가 1억원, 최고위원 후보가 5천만원이었다. 지난 19일 이재명 대통령은 엑스(X)에 “가능하다면 기탁금을 종전 수준으로 되돌리는 걸 고려해보시면 어떨까 한다”고 제안했다.)

Reports by Ko Han-sol, Jeong Hye-min, and Ko Kyung-ju sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 정혜민 고경주 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Repealing Supplementary Investigations Would Be Worst-Case Reform" "Unchecked Prosecutors Are the Real Danger" (“보완수사 폐지 땐 최악 개혁” “통제없는 검사가 진짜 위험”)
item.description:
On the 21st, the Democratic Party of Korea held a policy caucus meeting on the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority to hear expert opinions. Amid rising voices within and outside the party to allow supplementary investigation authority on an exceptional basis following the 'Jang Yun-gi case', experts attending the caucus were sharply divided between support and opposition. <<> Professor Park Chan-woon of Hanyang University Law School, former head of the Advisory Committee of the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office, argued in his presentation that "the core of prosecution reform is not supplementary investigations, and if supplementary investigations are also abolished, prosecution reform will become the worst possible outcome." He expressed concern that "the abolition of supplementary investigations is a product of the anger toward the prosecution that spread after Yoon Seok-youl's impeachment" and "if handled poorly, the abolition of supplementary investigations could lead to a crisis for the Democratic Party administration." <<> In contrast, Professor Yoo Seung-ik of Myongji University (Law) countered the argument that supplementary investigation authority should be partially retained to protect victims, stating, "Victim protection is not a task that can be resolved by relying on prosecutors' charitable goodwill or direct investigation powers." Meanwhile, Professor Hwang Mun-gyu of Joongbu University (Police Administration) proposed an alternative, saying, "To mitigate the side effects of abolishing supplementary investigation authority, we could consider granting complainants, accusers, and victims the right to request a meeting with prosecutors, and giving prosecutors the authority to verify facts." <<> Attorney Kang Dong-pil, a former police officer, said, "Even without prosecutors' supplementary investigations, the police already handle investigative work in practice, so abolishing the authority poses no problem. The real danger is prosecutors' direct investigations without oversight," adding, "If we retain supplementary investigation authority, will prosecutors come to the scene for every single case to look for cable ties, as was problematic in the Jang Yun-gi case?" <<> Attorney Kim Kyu-hyun, a former prosecutor, referred to the Jang Yun-gi case, the Kim Chang-min director case, and the Busan kicking incident, stating, "Supplementary investigation authority is an essential power for investigations related to people's livelihoods. If we just abolish it now, a string of second and third Jang Yun-gi cases will erupt before the general and presidential elections. We must not rush into this fire pit that could cost us the government, like moths to a flame." Kim Hye-jeong, head of the Korea Sexual Violence Relief Center, said regarding the right to demand supplementary investigations, "The 2021 adjustment of investigation authority between police and prosecutors was an extremely difficult change for victims. Claiming everything will work out perfectly is unrealistic. If we must abolish it, there needs to be a process of persuasion." <<> Lawmaker Hong Gi-won, who proposed a bill to exceptionally retain supplementary investigation authority for cases involving socially vulnerable groups, secured an opportunity to speak, saying, "Granting supplementary investigation authority itself is about protecting victims, because no one outside the police can see distortions or mistakes in police investigations." When Professor Hwang Mun-gyu criticized his bill as "revealing an intention for comprehensive re-investigation power," Hong countered, "The bill clearly states that supplementary investigations must be conducted within the scope of the same offense, and if different charges emerge, it requires notifying investigative agencies (police, Serious Crime Investigation Office, etc.) to prevent separate investigations." <<> Meanwhile, the meeting hall, initially filled with lawmakers at the start of the caucus, became sparse as many left during the expert presentations. By the end of the meeting, only about 10 lawmakers remained. The National Assembly will open the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's first subcommittee on bill review on the 22nd to deliberate on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment. <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 21일 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 관한 정책 의원총회를 열어 전문가 의견을 들었다. ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 당 안팎에서 보완수사권을 예외적으로 허용해야 한다는 목소리가 고개를 든 가운데 의총에 참석한 전문가들의 찬반 입장 또한 팽팽히 갈렸다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: “‘New Lee Jae-myung’ Leader Likely President Lee…Prosecution Reform a Total Mess” (유시민 “‘뉴이재명’ 수장은 이 대통령일 가능성…검찰개혁 모든 게 엉망”)
item.description:
Writer Yoo Si-min said on the 21st that he "judged that the leader of the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is likely President Lee Jae-myung." This came as he argued that the 'confusion' that arose during the push for prosecution reform ultimately stemmed from the president's decisions. (유시민 작가가 “(이른바) ‘뉴이재명' 세력의 수장은 이재명 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다”고 21일 말했다. 검찰개혁 추진 과정에서 벌어진 ‘혼선’이 결국 이 대통령의 판단에 따른 것이라는 주장을 하면서다.)

Appearing on the YouTube show '2-Minute News' that day, Yoo criticized the Democratic Party of Korea's process of pushing for prosecution reform—including whether to retain supplementary investigative powers—calling it "misguided in both distinction (of public and private) and priorities, a total mess," and made these remarks. (유 작가는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 보완수사권 존치 여부 등을 둘러싼 더불어민주당의 검찰개혁 추진 과정을 “공사(구분)도, 우선순위도 잘못됐고, 모든 게 엉망이었다”고 비판하며 이같이 말했다.)

He said, "After observing the past six months, I've come to judge that it's not because (the president) had no time or was focused elsewhere. There's a high probability that all of this was orchestrated by the president," adding, "All the actions of 'New Lee Jae-myung' aren't just some riot by the self-proclaimed 'pro-Lee' faction, but something planned and initiated by the president and some aides we don't know well." (그는 “(지난) 6개월을 지켜본 결과, (이 대통령이) 시간이 없어서 또는 다른 데 집중하느라 그런 게 아니고, 이 모든 일은 이 대통령이 기획한 것일 가능성이 많다고 판단하게 됐다”며 “‘뉴이재명’이 하는 모든 행동이 자칭 ‘친명’(친이재명계)들이 벌이는 난동이 아니라 대통령과 우리가 잘 알지 못하는 어떤 참모들이 기획해 시작한 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "I've judged that the leader of the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is not someone like Lee Eon-ju (Democratic Party lawmaker), but likely President Lee himself. I think it's time to speak up now." (그는 이어 “‘뉴이재명' 세력의 수장은 이언주 (민주당 의원) 같은 이런 사람이 아니고 이 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다. 이제는 말을 해야 할거 같다”고 했다.)

'New Lee Jae-myung' was initially a term coined to refer to the new influx of President Lee's supporters after last year's presidential election, but through the conflict phase over the merger between the Democratic Party and the Fatherland Innovation Party, it has come to be used among supporters to denote a faction distinct from the pro-Chung Cheong-rye and pro-Moon Jae-in factions. (‘뉴이재명'은 지난해 대선 이후 새로 유입된 이 대통령 지지층을 뜻하는 용어로 처음 만들어졌으나, 민주당과 조국혁신당의 합당 갈등 국면을 거치며 지지자들 사이에서 친정청래계·친문재인계와 구분되는 이 대통령 지지 세력을 지칭하는 표현으로 사용되고 있다.)

Yoo remarked, "The (amendment to) the Criminal Procedure Act (regarding whether to retain supplementary investigative powers) was supposed to be handled after the local elections. They ended the TF (the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office) activities, saying 'There's no government proposal. We'll leave it to the National Assembly,' and then lawmakers claiming to be pro-Lee introduced strange bills. They even put forward a Criminal Procedure Act amendment inconsistent with the Heavy Crime Investigation Office and the Corruption Investigation Office Act," adding, "Now it's time to see all this as the president's judgment." He further stated, "I can only judge that all of this happens because the president opposes the complete separation of investigation and prosecution. My hypothesis is that (the president) wants to keep the prosecution's investigative powers." (유 작가는 “(보완수사권 존치 여부를 결정할) 형사소송법(개정)은 지방선거가 끝난 뒤 하기로 하고, 티에프(TF·국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단) 활동을 종료하면서 ‘정부안은 없다. 국회에 맡기겠다’ 그래놓고 소위 친명을 자처하는 의원들은 이상한 법안을 냈다. 중수청(중대범죄수사청)·공수청법과 맞지도 않는 형사소송법 개정안을 또 내놨다”며 “이제는 이 모든 것이 대통령의 판단이라고 봐야 할 때가 됐다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이 모든 것들이 다 대통령이 수사·기소의 완전한 분리에 반대하기 때문에 생긴 일이라고밖에 판단할 수밖에 없다. (대통령이) 검찰의 수사권을 남겨놓고 싶어한다는 게 (제) 가설”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Yoo also said, "Absolute power corrupts 100%. No matter how high-quality the fish sold at a fishmonger's, it's bound to smell fishy. If left unchecked with no restrictions, every fishmonger will emit a stench." He added, "If you drive away critics saying 'Don't defame the fishmonger,' 'Are you inciting anti-fishmonger sentiment?' and silence them, eventually a rotten smell will emerge." (유 작가는 또한 “절대 권력은 100% 부패한다”며 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 파는 어물전도 비린내가 나기 마련이고, 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 썩은 내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다. 그는 “‘어물전 명예훼손하지 마’, ‘반(反)어물전 선동하는 것 아니냐’며 비판하는 사람을 쫓아내고 아무 말도 못 하게 하면 결국 썩은 내가 나게 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

By Ko Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)
